name: Juniper berry oil
description: Juniper berry oil ( CAS 8012-91-7 ), also known as juniper oil, is a steam-distilled essential oil obtained from the berries of Juniperus communis. Carrying FEMA 2604 status, it delivers a crisp, woody-balsamic aromatic profile. This profile drives its commercial demand across flavoring, fragrance, and personal care applications. In the food and beverage industry, it functions as a natural flavoring agent in gin botanicals, spirits, and marinades. It is also utilized in savory seasonings where a resinous, piney character is required. Fragrance formulators incorporate it into masculine and forest-themed fine fragrances, eau de colognes, and functional scenting for soaps. In personal care, it is used in scalp treatments, toning skincare formulations, and bath products. Its aromatic profile supports product positioning across various consumer goods and cosmetic applications. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturers also source it as a botanical flavoring component in oral preparations and herbal product lines. Juniper berry oil is supplied as a mobile, pale liquid in various packaging. Options range from small amber glass bottles to bulk drums for industrial use. It is available in food-grade quality meeting FCC and FEMA standards, as well as cosmetic-grade specifications. These specifications are aligned with ISO essential oil requirements for global distribution.
